updates.title: Software Updates
updates.subtitle: Checks the latest published Ground Station release on GitHub.
updates.available_body: Version {{latest}} is available. This installation is running version {{current}}.
updates.current_title: Ground Station is up to date
updates.current_body: The running version matches the latest published GitHub release.
updates.pending_body: The release check has not completed yet.
updates.instructions_intro: The GitHub release workflow publishes one multi-architecture image for AMD64 and ARM64. Docker selects the correct image automatically.
updates.step_review: Review the release notes and record the options used to start the current container.
updates.step_backup: Back up the host directory mounted at /app/backend/data. This directory contains the database and station data.
updates.step_replace: Stop and remove the existing container:
updates.step_restart: Start the new container with the command for your architecture and networking mode. Replace /path/to/data with the same host data directory used by the previous container.
updates.host_network_title: Host networking (recommended for SoapySDR Remote discovery)
updates.host_network_port_note: For a different HTTP port with host networking, change GS_HTTP_PORT=7000 to your chosen port. Docker ignores -p in this mode. The backend remains on port 7001.
updates.bridge_network_port_note: For a different HTTP port with bridge networking, change the host side of -p 7000:7000, for example to -p 8080:7000.
updates.persistence_note: Keep the existing /app/backend/data volume mapping. Removing a container does not remove a bind-mounted host directory, but starting without the same mapping will make the new container use a different data directory.

feedback.title: Help shape Ground Station
feedback.introduction: Would you like to help us understand which systems Ground Station runs on? Sharing a small census report helps us choose the hardware and operating systems to support and test. Thank you for considering it.
feedback.optional: This is optional and off by default. Saying no does not change any Ground Station features. This choice applies to this installation, and an administrator can change it at any time in Settings > Feedback. Nothing is sent until you save your choice or complete setup.
feedback.census_help: Allow this Ground Station backend to send the census fields listed below. No browser tracking or manual written feedback is collected.
feedback.environment_help: Set automatically by the backend deployment configuration.
feedback.performance_help: Not available yet. No performance metrics, diagnostics or crash reports are sent, and enabling census does not grant consent for them.
feedback.reported_help: Only if you choose to share the installation census.

fields.identity: Installation identity A random ID that lets us recognize reports from the same installation. It is not based on your name, account or hardware.
fields.application: Application Your Ground Station version and release type, how it is installed, and whether it is used for normal operation, development or testing.
fields.os: Operating system Your operating system and version, plus the type of processor it runs on, such as x86 or ARM.
fields.cpu: CPU Processor brand, model and the core count reported by your system.
fields.gpu: GPU Graphics card brand and model, when available, for up to four cards. We also record if no card is found or its details cannot be read.
fields.ip: Network We use and store only the public IP address seen by our reporting service. Census reporting never looks up, reads, collects or sends your local/private IP addresses. Your network or VPN determines the public address we see.
fields.activity: Reporting activity When this installation joined, when you enabled or disabled sharing, when the first and latest reports arrived, and which days it reported in the past week. This helps us count active installations.
fields.country: Country An approximate country based on your public IP address. We do not determine your city or exact location, and we do not send your IP address to an outside lookup service. A VPN may change the country shown.

feedback.privacy: These reports are pseudonymous, not fully anonymous. A persistent installation ID, hardware details and public IP address can identify an installation. Reports go to the Ground Station project team; the statistics console is private and requires sign-in. Only console administrators can view raw IP addresses.
feedback.excluded_help: These details are never included in census reports.

excluded_fields.identity: Station identity Your station name and callsign.
excluded_fields.location: Station location Your station coordinates and precise location.
excluded_fields.accounts: Accounts and passwords Account usernames, email addresses and passwords.
excluded_fields.network: Local network Census reporting never looks up, reads, collects or sends your local/private IP addresses. Hostnames and MAC addresses also stay local.
excluded_fields.targets: Tracked targets The satellites and other targets you track.
excluded_fields.recordings: Recordings and decoded data Your recordings and decoded content.
excluded_fields.files: Files and logs Your files and application logs.
excluded_fields.browser: Browser details Browser information and browser tracking data.

feedback.delivery_title: Where it goes, how often, and how to stop
feedback.delivery: The backend sends reports over HTTPS to https://reports.gscontrol.net. After opt-in, a report is sent shortly afterward, then approximately once per day with a small random delay. Delivery retries use timeouts and backoff. Reports continue while the backend runs, even with no browser open.
feedback.retention: We keep only the latest census report and approximate country for each installation. The public IP address is updated with each report and deleted seven days after the last report. After 60 days without a report, the census data and country are deleted and your permission to report expires. We also keep a record of which days reports arrived in the past week, rather than a full report history.
feedback.withdrawal: Turn off census and save to stop new reports and request deletion of the stored census snapshot, derived country code and IP address. If delivery is unavailable, the deletion request stays pending locally and is retried when possible. The shared random identity and a withdrawal record can remain temporarily; with no other reporting purpose, they expire after one unused day. An administrator may need to resolve an authentication error before deletion can complete.
feedback.saved: Your feedback preferences have been saved.
feedback.unsaved: Unsaved changes — use Save to apply your choice.
feedback.connection_required: A backend connection is required to manage feedback.
feedback.storage_error: Feedback storage is unreadable. Reporting is stopped; an administrator must repair local storage before changing consent.
feedback.deletion_pending: Census reporting is off. Deletion of the previously stored census and IP is pending. Keep the backend running so it can retry, and refresh to check progress.
feedback.blocked: The collector rejected this request. Automatic submissions have stopped. Review the error; saving an enabled census choice explicitly renews consent. Saving an off choice retries withdrawal.
feedback.refresh_help: Use Refresh to check delivery or deletion progress. Collector failures do not affect your station.
feedback.preview_help: Generated locally on this backend when you load or refresh this page. Viewing it sends nothing to the collector. This shows the sample body; authentication, observed IP and receipt metadata are described above. Hardware may change before the next report.
feedback.country_review: Country inference is now available. Your existing census consent remains active without country inference. Review the updated disclosure and save your feedback preferences to enable it, or turn census off to withdraw.
